messages:
sasha: Quick thread to finalize the benchmark narrative for the launch landing page. Primary goal: make the latency vs cost tradeoff visceral and actionable for three buyer personas (mobile/chat, search, rerank). Need: one hero visual, one interactive probe idea, and clear routing/CTA per persona.
leo: Hero should be two tiers: top-level single-panel that non-technical buyers get (cost bands + SLA bands), and a second expandable panel with a cost-composition waterfall and a p50/p95 comparison. Avoid log axes in hero.
rachel: Design constraints: hero must read at social size (1200x628). Use big SLA markers (200ms, 500ms, 2s) and a short legend: "p50 dots, p95 rings". I'll produce both static hero + small interactive SVG for the probe. :art:
matt: Probe idea: "Estimate for your workload" — paste a sample prompt or select persona -> returns estimated p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens with high/low bands. Keep the probe lightweight (simulator using our benchmark CSV). Routing rules: quick-probe -> self-serve, if monthly_tokens_est > 60M OR target_SLA == "<500ms" -> sales. We'll push events to GA + webhook. Example logic: `if est_monthly_tokens >= 60_000_000 || est_p95 < 500 -> tag:enterprise`
qa-bot: new benchmark snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2026-01-12/clarity-probe-v1.csv :link:
leo: Placeholder CSV for design (label as sample):
```
model,persona,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,avg_history
fast-lite,mobile_chat,92,210,0.58,18
search-core,search,340,780,0.33,140
sparse-quant,rerank,185,450,0.10,56
```
sasha: Microcopy for hero headline: "See how speed choices change your bill". Subhead: "Real-world latency vs cost for three common workloads — plus a quick probe for your own prompts."
rachel: For the hero annotation: include a small methodology pill: `test harness: warm-cache, steady QPS window, seq len by persona (20/128/64), batch auto`. Footnote for any <150ms claim: "measured at p50 under 10-50 sustained QPS and short histories (<32 tokens)".
matt: Probe GA event spec (draft): `event: clarity_probe`, props: persona, est_p50, est_p95, est_cost_per_1k, monthly_tokens_guess, tags[] . Webhook payload will include the same fields + returned CSV sample id.
leo: Visuals: hero panel (SLA bands + 3 persona points with p95 halos), expandable panel with waterfall per persona (tokens | compute | infra overhead) and inset "cost vs QPS" lines so finance sees predictability. Color palette: chat=teal, search=amber, rerank=indigo.
sasha: Webinar hook: "Latency vs cost: a practical playbook" — 20m narrative + 20m live probe demo + 15m Q/A. Speakers: rachel (visuals + copy), matt (probe demo), leo (bench methodology). Date: two weeks from asset sign-off.
rachel: CTA copy tests: Quick-probe = "Estimate latency & spend in 60s"; Demo = "See a 5-min replay on your workload"; Enterprise = "Talk to capacity & SLAs". Keep CTAs under 5 words.
matt: Sales caution: if we display <200ms for chat, add a clear asterisk with the measurement constraints. Also include a small expandable FAQ: "What changes latency most? history length, QPS, model variant."
sasha: Action items: 1) leo = lock final CSV + waterfall numbers by Tue EOD, 2) rachel = hero mock + methodology pill + CTA variants by Wed noon, 3) matt = probe UX spec, GA events, webhook schema by Wed EOD, 4) qa-bot = make benchmark CSV accessible and tag run. Reconvene Fri 9:30 to approve assets. Thanks everyone :rocket:
